# link target: git cat-file blob <blob> (raw readlink text, no trailing newline); r27 and r28 hold zero 120000 paths (r26 holds all 14)
# resolved_at_rev: relative targets normpath-joined to the link parent; absolute targets kept as the raw host path; dangling = resolved repo path absent from the committed tree at rev
# source_verbatim: readlink of .ufo/waves/round-<N>/<path_rel> on disk equals the committed target (cp -a preservation, never dereferenced)
# disposition: RECORD = write the verbatim pair into census/round-<N>/waves/symlinks.tsv; REFUSE-AND-ACCOUNT = absolute target, must not be committed in a fresh capture, accounting row required
# the first two columns are exactly the frozen C2 ledger format (col1 path relative to the waves dir, col2 raw target)
